messages:
jordan: Quick sync — planning a Stargazer Dedicated + VPC on-prem review call. Need to lock a time and agree agenda/owners. Proposed slots (PT): Tue 10:00-11:00, Wed 14:00-15:00, Thu 08:00-09:00. React with ✅ for what works or suggest alternatives.

Draft agenda:
```
1) Rollout scope & pinned model/image (owner: alice)
2) Network topologies + subnet mapping (owner: lee)
3) Storage perf & NVMe sizing (owner: samir)
4) Security/KMS + access checks (owner: dan)
5) Canary/rollback plan + telemetry (owner: jordan)
6) Customer preflight artifacts & next steps
```

Ask: please confirm you can join and that your preflight artifacts (connectivity matrix, load profile) are uploaded to the runbook before the call. I’ll send calendar once we have a majority.

lee: ✅ Tue 10 works for infra. I'll bring the subnet map and route table diff. Please add "verify NAT gateway egress rules" to network checklist.

maya: Wed 14 is better for me — customer SE prefers EMEA-friendly window. If we pick Tue can someone record?

samir: I can do storage perf checks. Need expected QPS and seq/rand ratios. Pushed a sample load profile to the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/stargazer-preflight

alice: Can someone paste current pinned model version & container image tag? Also: we should include quantization/FP settings in the notes.

dan: I'll own security/KMS verifications. Quick checklist I plan to run: 1) confirm KMS key access from customer VPC 2) validate audit logs flow 3) run security scanner on image tag.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach preflight artifact before the meeting. Use `/preflight create stargazer` to generate the artifact link for invite.

jordan: Thanks — rough tally: lee, samir, dan, alice, ops-bot prefer Tue; maya prefers Wed. I can record if we keep Tue. Finalizing invite for Tue 10:00 PT.

maya: :thumbsup: If Tue is locked, I’ll join remotely and we can follow up with a quick separate session for the customer SE if needed.

lee: Pinged the customer SE, they tentatively confirmed Tue 10. Added them to the invite draft.

jordan: OK — I'll send the calendar + runbook link and attach the preflight checklist. Please have artifacts uploaded 24h before. If any critical blocker appears, flag here and we can reschedule.

samir: noted. I'll upload NVMe perf baseline and a minimal load script today.

alice: I'll paste the container tag and model sha in the runbook in next 30m.

dan: Good. Also will run the image scanner and post results to the thread once done.

jordan: Closing — invite out in 10m. Thanks everyone.
